olivia: Quick heads-up: saw tenants get billed twice when they call /v1 with X-Api-Version:2. Minimal repro below.

harry: Paste?

olivia: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'X-Api-Version: 2' \n  -d '{"model":"embed-medium","inputs":["a","b"]}'
```

olivia: Router records route_hit=v1 then hands to v2 compat handler which also emits invocation_meter -> double count.

harry: Root cause: duplicate metering in router + executor for fallthrough path. We already suppressed for streaming but missed batch endpoint.

billing: Impact: ~12 tenants hit quota unexpectedly. Billing team preparing credits list.

olivia: Short fixes: (1) router set internal header X-Redwood-Metered (strip at edge) so downstream skips duplicate emit (hotfix); (2) mute quota emails for suspected duplicates; (3) console toggle to view raw vs deduped usage.

devops-bot: Canary planned: router-meter-dedupe -> 5% at 1744325000.

harry: Long term: change semantics so only final handler emits billing events and update deprecation docs re: header negotiation.

console-bot: Ticket created: PLAT-7430 (router dedupe), PLAT-7431 (console UI), BILL-6200 (credits).
